metadata.title: Seedance 2.0 AI Video Generator | Seadance Video
metadata.description: Create video from text, images, or an existing clip with the currently supported Seedance 2.0 workflow. Follow Seedance 2.5 release updates on Seadance Video.

page.title: Seedance AI Video Generator
page.description: Create a video from a written scene, reference image, or existing clip. Seedance 2.0 is currently available; Seedance 2.5 will be added only after official access is supported.

items.question: Which generation modes are available?
items.answer: Text-to-Video composes a clip from a written scene, Image-to-Video animates a still image, and Video-to-Video remixes an existing clip from its URL.

items.question: Which Seedance version is available?
items.answer: The generator currently uses Seedance 2.0 models configured by the site administrator. Seedance 2.5 is not yet available through this site.

items.question: How long can a generated clip be?
items.answer: Available duration options depend on the selected model, input mode, and resolution.

items.question: What resolutions and aspect ratios are supported?
items.answer: Seedance 2.0 options include 480p, 720p, and 1080p where available, plus common aspect ratios such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, and 3:4.

items.question: How are credits charged?
items.answer: Credit cost depends on the generation mode, model, duration, and resolution. The estimate is shown before you submit the task.

items.question: Can I use generated videos commercially?
items.answer: Commercial use depends on your plan, the selected provider's model policy, and applicable law. Review the Terms of Service before publishing paid work.

cta.title: Turn an Idea into Motion
